description: Department of Census and statistics - The National Consumer Price Index - June 2023
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for June 2023, which is statistical information published by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any of the specialized categories (Types 4-9) as it is not about land, legal matters, commerce, elections, public service, or judicial matters. This falls under general administrative/statistical information, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
